name: Mary Agrotechnologies Inc.
summary: Mary Agrotechnologies Inc. is an agriculture technology firm dedicated to developing and supplying automated cultivation systems for both home growers and commercial enterprises. Their product line includes advanced automated machines for personal use and industrial-grade container units, designed for growing various herbs and vegetables across the globe. Additionally, the company undertakes the planning, establishment, and operation of specialized container farms. Founded in 2017, Mary Agrotechnologies maintains its corporate headquarters in Markham, Canada.
